rationale: The agent authenticated the user properly using full name and ZIP when the provided email didn’t match the system record. They pulled the user and order details via read-only tools before taking action. The agent sought explicit confirmation before attempting to cancel a single item and, when the system disallowed item removal (exchange-only), they corrected course and obtained explicit confirmation to cancel the entire order. They then executed the cancellation using the appropriate tool and provided refund details to the correct card on file. Although the agent initially (and incorrectly) stated that a single item could be cancelled, they promptly corrected this after the tool error and proceeded in line with policy. No unauthorized disclosures or actions occurred, and the final outcome and information appear consistent with the tools and policy.
